name: Leading Edge Data Centres Albury-Wodonga edge data centre
notes: Leading Edge lists Albury as one of its regional edge data centre locations; ARN and DCD reported the Albury-Wodonga Tier III regional facility opened in 2022 after a roughly A$7m investment.

name: Leading Edge Bathurst Data Centre
notes: Bathurst Regional Council approved a Tier III data centre on Panorama Avenue next to Bathurst TAFE; Leading Edge said the Bathurst site was one of 14 planned regional NSW hubs and would use a solar shield over the facility.

name: Bathurst Regional Data Centre
notes: INTREC describes a Bathurst Regional Data Centre with 1.5MW supply, designed, developed and managed by INTREC as a regional data centre hub. Relationship to the separately approved Leading Edge Panorama Avenue site is unclear, so it is recorded as a distinct operational facility.

name: Equinix Sydney SY1/SY2 Mascot data centres
notes: Equinix lists SY1 and SY2 at 639 Gardeners Road, Mascot, which is in the Bayside Council area; both pages describe operational Sydney colocation facilities and interconnection services.

name: Goodman Project Duke Data Centre
notes: NSW Planning Portal describes construction and operation of a 90 MVA data centre at 2 and 10-22 Kent Road, Mascot, with determination documents published; Urban Digest reported the A$1.18bn Mascot project was approved with conditions.

name: CDC Marsden Park Data Centre Campus
notes: NSW Planning Portal describes a 504MW Marsden Park data centre with six four-storey buildings and a 720MW substation; CDC announced ground-breaking for the Marsden Park Industrial Precinct campus and describes planned capacity over 504MW, scalable toward 1GW.

name: AirTrunk SYD1 Sydney West
notes: AirTrunk lists SYD1 Sydney West as a hyperscale campus with 130+MW capacity, 7.4ha site, 35,000 sqm technical data hall area and 42 data halls; DCD reported completion of the fifth and final building at the 130MW Sydney campus.

name: AirTrunk SYD3 Sydney West
notes: AirTrunk describes SYD3 Sydney West as Asia-Pacific's largest hyperscale data centre by megawatts; the company announced a 320+MW Western Sydney campus, and DCD reported the planning filing for a 320MW facility at 51 Huntingwood Drive in Blacktown.
